name: terminal-demo-panel
title: Terminal Demo Panel
description: A terminal demo panel is a self-playing two-pane pitch: a terminal types a command, streams its response lines, then a browser-style result pane slides open beside it — compressing "you ask, it ships" into a loop the visitor watches instead of reads. Playback is pausable and prefers-reduced-motion renders finished states without typing animation. Not an interactive shell or a code block.
